name: B10-0541/2025 (Renew) – Escalating repression of the Baha’is in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalating repression of the Baha’is in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Iran to stop persecuting Baha'is, its largest unrecognised religious minority. It asks Iran to release Baha'is held on false charges, return confiscated property, and end policies that block their education, jobs and pensions. It also asks the European Union and its member states to sanction Iranian judges, prosecutors and intelligence officials involved in this persecution, and to make human rights progress a condition of EU talks with Iran. This is a statement of demands, not a change in law.

- The European Union is asked to freeze assets and ban visas of Iranian officials tied to persecution.
- Iran is asked to free detained Baha'is, return property and end discrimination.
- The resolution is sent to Iran, EU bodies and the United Nations; no law changes yet.
